message:
feat: no prices on beequips, and the app opens the home page again

A beequip has no price of its own — what it is worth depends on the roll you
happened to get, so the number was noise. The catalogue at /items/ and
/ru/items/ now shows the 41 beequips without a price, sorted by name, with a
note in the section header. Clicking one still leads to the item page where
the rolls and their buffs can be looked up.

The totals on the page leave beequips out too: "total value" was 9.6k, but
8.3k of that was the sum of the beequip base values. It is 1.3k now, and the
most expensive item is Bee Cub at 290 instead of Pink Shades at 2.3k — which
was a beequip as well.

The English home page opens with the app again, the way it did before the
static block was added on top. The block moved below the app, so it is still
in the document for crawlers. The Russian landing page keeps its landing on
top — that page has always been a landing page.
author: BSS Index Developer
